post/sources.json.why: A plain sources run links only the parcels new since the last run. 3 rows on 2026-10-16 came from an upstream load; on a settled DB it writes 0 (2026-10-18 fleet retake), so the #38 evidence is post/standalone-forced.json (R-DP bracket).

post/standalone-forced.json.why: #38 evidence (Spec 124 R-DP, 2026-10-18). The step is INSERT-only (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, class D), so no column can be perturbed. The R-DP delete_reinsert bracket deletes every bridge row of the first 200 parcel_ids (260 rows); under the descriptor force env (recovery.force) the full re-scan re-inserts all 260 (records_new 260) and the pair set matches the before-image (restore re-inserted 0). The old env-only recipe wrote 0 on the settled DB: its earlier nonzero capture came from upstream drift.
